propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) instead of reading the admin-settable jira.text.field.character.limit property, causing silent data loss when an administrator raises or removes the limit
comments longer than 32767 but shorter than the instance's configured ceiling are truncated and differ permanently between local and remote, even though Jira would accept them
the DC comment sanitizer reuses the description fitter (fit_outbound), creating a latent trap where future changes to description fitting silently retarget comment truncation
the constant WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT is misattributed in comments to Cloud limits rather than the jira.text.field.character.limit default, reversing actual causality

the fix makes comment ceiling configurable via [tool.rebar.reconciler].comment_max_chars with default 32767, decouples sanitize_comment from the description fitter, and records why live endpoint discovery was dropped
